FROM node@sha256:ecefaffd4706c5879af52e022fdb8ea30cbd6590e2a30d05347790d690727c6c AS nodejs
FROM hexpm/elixir@sha256:c129490fa75f7d00a28e293eb8ee5e00d1b7b34da03748b998369e41ef8a0a1e
USER root
RUN if command -v apk; then apk add --no-cache git python3 bash ca-certificates build-base brotli libstdc++; else apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git python3 bash ca-certificates build-essential brotli && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; fi
RUN if command -v useradd; then useradd -m -u 1000 agent; else adduser -D -u 1000 agent; fi
COPY --from=nodejs /usr/local/bin/node /usr/local/bin/node
COPY --from=nodejs /usr/local/lib/node_modules /usr/local/lib/node_modules
RUN ln -s /usr/local/lib/node_modules/npm/bin/npm-cli.js /usr/local/bin/npm && ln -s /usr/local/lib/node_modules/npm/bin/npx-cli.js /usr/local/bin/npx
WORKDIR /workspace
ENV MIX_ENV="ce_test"
ENV MIX_HOME="/opt/mix"
ENV HEX_HOME="/opt/hex"
ENV ERL_FLAGS="+S 2:2"
ENV NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=2048"
RUN mix local.hex --force && mix local.rebar --force
COPY source/mix.exs source/mix.lock ./
COPY source/config/ config/
RUN mix deps.get --only ce_test && mix deps.compile
COPY source/tracker/package.json source/tracker/package-lock.json tracker/
RUN npm ci --prefix tracker --no-audit --no-fund
COPY source/ /workspace/
RUN npm run deploy --prefix tracker
RUN test -s priv/tracker/js/plausible-web.js
RUN mix compile
RUN rm -rf .git && git init && git config user.name Benchmark && git config user.email benchmark@localhost && git add . && git commit -m 'Initial task workspace'
RUN chown -R agent:agent /workspace /opt/mix /opt/hex
USER agent
CMD ["sleep", "infinity"]
